_about: Second held-out set of management sentences, written after the fixes and never used to change a rule. Same conventions as guidance_sentences.json (call Q2 FY27, 29 Oct 2026).

items.s: We now expect FY27 revenue growth of 11% to 13%.
EBITDA margin for FY27 should be around 17%.
Freight cost increases of 4% will weigh on margins in Q3.
items.trap: a cost increase read as a margin target

items.s: We plan capex of Rs. 900 crore in FY27, of which Rs. 350 crore was incurred in Q1.
items.trap: spent-so-far amount or quarter read as the target

items.s: Our revenue grew 14% in H1, and we expect similar momentum to continue.
items.trap: a reported H1 figure carried into guidance

items.s: We are aiming for strong double-digit EBITDA growth.
items.trap: vague phrase turned into a specific number

items.s: The street is expecting 25% margins, which is not something we have guided to.
Credit cost should be 2.2% plus or minus 20 basis points this year.
We expect net debt to reduce by Rs. 800 crore over the next two years.
items.trap: a two-year reduction scored as a FY27 level

items.s: For FY27 we are maintaining our capex guidance of Rs. 1,100 crore.
Wage hikes of 7% to 8% were rolled out in October.
items.trap: a wage hike read as margin or revenue guidance

items.s: We remain on track to deliver an EBIT margin of 21% to 23% for the year.
We hope to get back to double-digit growth by FY29.
items.trap: a FY29 aspiration scored against FY27

items.s: The effective tax rate should be about 24% in FY27.
items.trap: tax rate attributed to a tracked metric

items.s: We expect AUM growth of 20% to 22% in FY27.
We delivered 160 basis points of margin expansion in the first half.
items.trap: a reported outcome read as guidance
